summary: Frontend-only regression: NEW RIBBON REGALE (/inspiration-vault/gold-theory-ribbon) piece + Vault index card. Ran full acceptance suite at 375x800, 768x1024, 1440x900 plus category filters, gallery order/media assertions, video attribute audit, add-to-cart flow, and regression on all pre-existing Vault cards + STAMPEDE SET detail page. 100% of specified critical assertions pass. Only observation: the RIBBON REGALE Vault index card at 1440 desktop measures h≈1510px which exceeds the 1200px guideline from the review request, but the sibling STAMPEDE SET card is identical (h≈1510px) at the same viewport — this is inherent to the pre-existing single-column grid at 1440 combined with a 1:1 square image, not a RIBBON REGALE regression. Meta area occupies the natural ~225px below the image (no excess blank space).

issues: Card height ~1510px (>1200px guideline). Consistent with STAMPEDE SET (also 1510px) at same viewport — appears to be an inherent property of the single-column grid at 1440 with a 1:1 square poster. Not a scoping regression. If the >1200 constraint must be strictly enforced, cap card max-width via .ribbon-regale-vault-card at 1440 or reduce image aspect to 4:5.

critical_code_review_comments: Scoping of .ribbon-regale-vault-card is class-based and does NOT leak into sibling Vault cards (verified at runtime: sibling widths/heights match expected pre-existing sizes).

Archive tag and CTA text rendered as 'Archive Piece' / 'View Archive Piece' in DOM but appear uppercase visually via CSS text-transform. Any strict case-sensitive assertions should account for this (case-insensitive match is safe).

At 1440x900 desktop, RIBBON REGALE card renders ~1510px tall (image 1285x1285 + meta ~225px). This is because .ribbon-regale-vault-card sets aspect-ratio:auto + object-fit:contain, which is the intended safety fix, but at full 1440 grid width the square image dictates a tall card. STAMPEDE SET has the identical pattern at the same viewport, so this is not a new regression. If desktop <1200px is a hard requirement, consider adding a max-width cap on .ribbon-regale-vault-card (e.g. max-width:900px; margin:0 auto) at ≥1200 breakpoint.

GalleryMedia component correctly sets video.muted, .volume=0, .playsInline in useEffect and additionally renders the muted/autoplay/loop/playsInline/disablePictureInPicture attributes on the <video> element — belt-and-suspenders approach passes all DOM assertions.
action_items: OPTIONAL (only if hard-enforcing the 'not >1200px tall on desktop' rule): cap .ribbon-regale-vault-card width at ≥1200 breakpoint so the card body stays under 1200px, since 1:1 square image at full grid width naturally produces a >1500px card. Note: STAMPEDE SET currently exhibits the same behavior at 1440, so this would be a policy change for both.
context_for_next_testing_agent: RIBBON REGALE (/inspiration-vault/gold-theory-ribbon) is fully functional. Vault index card at data-testid='iv-card-gold-theory-ribbon' is properly scoped by .ribbon-regale-vault-card and does not affect sibling cards. Detail-page gallery has exactly 8 items in strict order [hero-pair-black, car-three-quarter, car-profile, cafe-lifestyle, mannequin-worn, pair-white, video-1, video-2]. Thumbs 7 & 8 mount <video data-testid='rr-gallery-video'> with muted=true, volume=0, controls=false, autoplay=true, loop=true, playsInline=true, disablePictureInPicture=true, object-fit:contain. No <video> tags for gold-theory-ribbon appear on /inspiration-vault index. Add-to-cart persists to localStorage['phileon_cart'] as JSON array with the correct fields. STAMPEDE SET and all other prior Vault pieces (DRIVEN, NOVA, CAGED WINGS, MONACO, ORIEL, PARABOLA ATELIER) remain intact. Only stylistic note: desktop 1440 card height is ~1510px matching STAMPEDE SET behavior — no scoping regression, but if the strict '>1200px' guideline needs to be enforced, main agent must add a max-width cap on the card at ≥1200 breakpoint.
